履修条件
The ecosystems on earth are in equilibrium, and homeostasis has been maintained between organisms and the environment, and material cycles have been smoothly carried out. There, an astronomical variety and number of microorganisms exist and perform important functions. The existence of microorganisms that maintain and conserve the global environment is essential for the construction of the global social system and is expected to play an important role in solving global-scale problems such as the environment, energy, and food.
In this lecture, the flow of research and classification of environmental microorganisms will be reviewed first, then the characteristics of taxonomy, morphology, and community structure of the target microorganisms will be comprehensively described, and the interaction of microorganisms, microorganisms and their living environment (hydrosphere, hydrosphere, and extreme environment), roles and functions of microorganisms related to plants, animals, and human society, and research related to environmental conservation and environmental purification through the use of microorganisms will be introduced.
授業概要
The ecosystem on the earth was in equilibrium, and constancy was kept between a creature and the environment, and cyclical change of materials has been performed smoothly. An astronomical kind and a numerical microbe exist and work important there. The existence of the microbe to maintain a global environment, and to keep in good condition is essential to the construction of the system of the planethood, and it is expected that I play role that is important to environment, energy, the solution to global problem including the food.
In this recture, we survey a flow and the classification of the study of the environmental microbe first and, by this lecture, explain a characteristic about a classification, a form, the crowd structure about a microbe becoming a target comprehensively and introduce about the role and function, a study in conjunction with environmental conservation and the environment purification by the use of the microbe about the interaction of the microbe, survival environment (the hydrosphere, soil zone, extreme environment) and a microbe, a microbe in conjunction with the animals and plants, the human being society.

全体の教育目標
The goal of the course is to provide students with a scientific understanding of the fundamentals of microbiology regarding the types, identification, and community structure of microorganisms, and to acquire specialized knowledge regarding humans and microorganisms, plants and animals and microorganisms, environmental conservation and microorganisms, fermented foods and microorganisms, and to acquire the ability to contribute to the solution of various problems occurring in the global environment, ecosystems, and human society in terms of environmental microorganisms.
